prompt: Can you make me a brand-by-brand deck of what these skincare brands are doing on social? I want to see product focus, who they're targeting by generation, and whether they're doing brand building or just tactical discount posts.
expected_output: Runs the scan, then build_deck.py with an authored reads.yaml. Deck has one slide per brand pairing the contact sheet with a read and a counted footer. Product focus, generation and content-balance tables appear in the findings.

assertions.desc: A .pptx exists, opens, and has one slide per brand.
Brand slides embed that brand's actual collected creative (contact sheet), not placeholder boxes or text only.
Product focus, audience generation, and brand-building vs tactical all appear as actual analysis with numbers - the three things the user explicitly asked for.
Per-brand judgements are anchored to counts from the sheet rather than asserted.
Deck states the sample limitation (capped N, organic-only, no spend) rather than burying or omitting it.
The per-brand reads quote actual ad copy, not generic descriptions.
No shape extends beyond the slide canvas.
